description: WebUI project CRUD management with search-based directory picker, empty state guidance

tasks.title: Add filesystem API endpoints (backend)
tasks.description: Create api/fs.ts with two endpoints: GET /api/fs/list (directory listing via fs.readdir, filters to directories only, excludes hidden dirs starting with .) and GET /api/fs/search (fuzzy directory search via system find command with maxdepth=4, path traversal guard ensuring resolved path stays under HOME). Register routes in server/index.ts. Response shape for both: { name: string, absolute: string }[].
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/fs/list?path=/home/user/repos returns array of { name, absolute } for subdirectories
GET /api/fs/list excludes hidden directories (starting with .) and .git
GET /api/fs/list returns 400 if path does not exist or is not a directory
GET /api/fs/search?query=myapp returns array of { name, absolute } matching directories under HOME
GET /api/fs/search limits to maxdepth=4 and default limit=50
GET /api/fs/search rejects paths that resolve outside HOME
Routes registered in server and accessible via /api/fs/*
tasks.notes: Use os.homedir() for HOME. For /api/fs/search on Unix: child_process.execFile('find', [home, '-type', 'd', '-maxdepth', '4', '-iname', `*${query}*`]). Windows fallback: dir /s /ad /b can be deferred to later. Use path.resolve() and .startsWith(home) for traversal guard.

tasks.title: Add project management and filesystem methods to API client
tasks.description: Add to api.ts: (1) Project management: createProject, deleteProject, useProject methods. (2) Filesystem: listDirectories(path) calling GET /api/fs/list, searchDirectories(query, limit) calling GET /api/fs/search. Add fuzzysort dependency to package.json.
acceptanceCriteria: api.createProject({name, path}) sends POST /api/projects and returns Project
api.deleteProject(name) sends DELETE /api/projects/:name
api.useProject(name) sends POST /api/projects/:name/use and returns Project
api.listDirectories(path) sends GET /api/fs/list?path=... and returns DirEntry[]
api.searchDirectories(query, limit) sends GET /api/fs/search?query=...&limit=... and returns DirEntry[]
fuzzysort added to package.json dependencies
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing api.ts patterns. DirEntry type: { name: string, absolute: string }.

tasks.title: Add project mutation hooks to useQueries
tasks.description: Add useCreateProject, useDeleteProject, useUseProject mutations using useMutation. Each mutation SHALL invalidate ['projects'] query on success.
acceptanceCriteria: useCreateProject calls api.createProject and invalidates ['projects'] on success
useDeleteProject calls api.deleteProject and invalidates ['projects'] on success
useUseProject calls api.useProject and invalidates ['projects'] on success
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing mutation patterns in useQueries.ts if any, otherwise use standard useMutation.

tasks.title: Create DialogSelectDirectory component
tasks.description: Create DialogSelectDirectory component with: search input supporting path mode (~/path or /absolute) and search mode (plain text), fuzzysort matching for directory names, Tab key path completion, recent projects list at top (from projects query), directory list display with folder icons. Reuse existing Dialog component. Reference OpenCode's DialogSelectDirectory for interaction design but implement with React + Tailwind.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input supports path mode: ~/repos/my segments resolved to absolute paths
Search input supports search mode: plain text calls api.searchDirectories
fuzzysort ranks directory results by relevance
Tab key auto-completes current path segment when unique match found
Top section shows recent projects (up to 5) from projects query
Clicking a directory calls onSelect callback with absolute path string and closes dialog
Hidden directories (. prefix) are not shown
Follows existing Dialog/Tailwind styling patterns
tasks.notes: Props: { open: boolean, onClose: () => void, onSelect: (path: string) => void }. Use os.homedir equivalent from api or a new /api/fs/home endpoint, or pass homeDir from ProjectContext. The path parsing logic (~ expansion, absolute vs relative, parent navigation) should mirror OpenCode's dialog-select-directory.tsx utility functions.

tasks.title: Add empty state for no projects
tasks.description: When projects array is empty, show empty state with 'No projects yet' message and 'Create Project' button instead of KanbanBoard and 'Loading...' text.
acceptanceCriteria: When projects.length === 0: empty state is shown with message
Empty state has 'Create Project' button that opens CreateProjectDialog
No 'Loading...' text shown when projects list is loaded but empty
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Modify App.tsx or KanbanBoard.tsx to conditionally render empty state. CreateProjectDialog will be wired in T-007.

tasks.title: Create CreateProjectDialog component
tasks.description: Create a dialog component with name input (required) and path selection via DialogSelectDirectory. The path field shows the selected path and has a 'Browse' button that opens DialogSelectDirectory. Handle 409 conflict error with inline message.
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog has name text input (required) and path display with 'Browse' button
Clicking 'Browse' opens DialogSelectDirectory, selected path fills the path field
Create button disabled when name or path is empty
On success: closes dialog, project list refreshes, current project switches to new project
On 409 error: shows 'Project name already exists' error, dialog stays open
Follows existing Dialog/CreateIssueDialog patterns and Tailwind styling
tasks.notes: Path field is read-only display — user must use the directory picker to select. This prevents invalid path input.

tasks.title: Add project actions to Header dropdown and wire dialogs
tasks.description: Add 'New Project' and 'Delete Project' items to the Header project dropdown. Wire empty state's 'Create Project' button to open CreateProjectDialog. Wire 'Delete Project' to show confirm dialog then call deleteProject mutation. Fix the existing open state collision bug in Header.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Header dropdown shows 'New Project' option that opens CreateProjectDialog
Header dropdown shows 'Delete Project' option (only when projects exist)
Empty state 'Create Project' button opens CreateProjectDialog
Delete shows confirmation dialog before calling API
After delete: project list refreshes, switches to first remaining project if current was deleted, or shows empty state if none left
Header.tsx open state bug fixed (dropdown and dialog use separate state)
tasks.notes: The existing Header.tsx has a bug where the dropdown open state and CreateIssueDialog share the same state variable. This should be fixed by using separate useState for each.
